name: Ledda, the Last Choirmistress
role: The one who survived learning the Sunken Choir's full song, and walked away
knowledge: The Choir's full song, and its price
⚑ How to take from the deep without being taken
What the song cost her, exactly
wants: To keep anyone else from making her mistakes, and to be left alone with the grief of what it cost
fears: ⚠️ Someone learning it badly. ⛔ She would have to go back.
appearance: Older than her years and entirely composed. She does not sing where anyone can hear.
voiceHints: Warm, brief, and closed on one subject. She will teach anything except that.

abilities.why: ⚑ 'sonic mastery to rival the Luminary's light'
'the grief of what the song cost her'
⛔ 'how to take from the deep WITHOUT BEING TAKEN' — the held note is the technique
she stood in one and came back
⚑ she is the counter-example to Corvane — she paid on purpose and lived
she does not soften what it cost

physicality: ADULT. Composed, prematurely grey, fifties. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she never sings, and everyone in the room knows why.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ 'She may relent for someone worth teaching.' ⛔ The one closed subject is what the song took, and a GM should let it stay closed until it does not.
questSeeds: ⚑ She is the mentor for the Precursor and sonic path, and she will refuse you once before she agrees.
⛔ Someone is learning the Choir's song badly. She knows, and going back is the one thing she said she would never do.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ PROMOTED FROM `npcs/legends.json` TO A FILE OF ITS OWN, 2026-09-08. ⛔ CCODE'S ROSTER: 'authored on disk, never loaded — 4, all in npcs/legends.json', and `state.js` claimed they 'arrive hydrated from legends.roster' WHICH THEY DO NOT. ⚠️ THE FILE IS REGISTERED IN THE MANIFEST AND ITS PEOPLE NEVER REACH THE GAME — the pooled-container failure a third time, after the coliseum champions and the Saehara challengers. ⛔ AND THREE OF THE FIVE ARE HINGES: `the_deep_warden` on FOUR of six arcs, `aevi_the_watcher` on two, `the_last_choirmistress` on two. ⚑ Erik: 'make them fully authored with their arc wants etc. THEY'RE FULL NPCS.' ⚠️ EVERY FIELD BELOW IS CARRIED FROM THE POOLED RECORD — role, power, wants, hooks, seenBefore, approachRequirement, canOppose/canAlly/canRecruit. ⛑ WHAT IS NEW IS ONLY WHAT A SHEET NEEDS: tier from renown, level from the tier floor, domains, subAttributes and a kit.
_vocationWhy: ⛔ `vocation` IS AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED, and the attempt to derive it is the reason. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-08: clustering 40 authored people by their crafts' verb families put SEVENTEEN OF FORTY in KEEPER and ZERO in EDGE — with KESTRIN, THE COLISEUM'S HARM CHAMPION, IN THE KEEPER COLUMN. ⛑ Rank-weighting did not fix it: she reads KEEPER 24 / READER 23 / EDGE 21, essentially flat. ⚑ THE CAUSE IS CLEAN: every capable person carries defensive and perceptive crafts, so verb counts measure COMPETENCE, not PURPOSE. ⛔ A VOCATION IS WHAT A PERSON IS FOR, and that is a judgement — the same shape as `tier`, which a regex also cannot mint. ⬜ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` holds the eight and what each does when a fight starts. ⚑ HERE: ⚠️ she survived the song and stayed to keep anyone else from making her mistakes.
